**Fastest valid route.** The image is the subgroup generated by $[3]_{18}$, which has order

$$\frac{18}{\gcd(18,3)}=6.$$

The finite-group homomorphism formula gives

$$|\ker\phi|=\frac{24}{6}=4.$$

The answer is **(C)**. Directly, $3x\equiv0\pmod{18}$ means $x\equiv0\pmod6$, giving the four classes $[0],[6],[12],[18]$ modulo $24$.
